title: Staged process start
brief: Program a process with two machines: a mixer followed by a transfer pump. Use the Run Request to start and stop the sequence.
requirements: Run Request (I0.0) controls two machines: Mixer Motor (Q0.0) and Transfer Pump (Q0.1). Both outputs must initially be OFF.
When Run Request (I0.0) turns ON, wait 3 continuous seconds before switching Mixer Motor (Q0.0) ON. Transfer Pump (Q0.1) must remain OFF during this first delay.
Once Mixer Motor has started, wait a further 2 seconds before switching Transfer Pump (Q0.1) ON (approximately 5 seconds after the original request).
While Run Request remains ON after both delays, keep Mixer Motor (Q0.0) and Transfer Pump (Q0.1) ON.
If Run Request (I0.0) turns OFF at any stage, turn both outputs OFF immediately and reset both delays. A later request must start the full sequence again.
hints: The first timer is enabled by Run Request; its Q bit controls the mixer and the second timer.
Use a second instance with PT T#2s. Drive the pump in a network after that timer.
